title: Perfect location
text: Five minutes on foot to the metro and the river. We walked everywhere, even up to the castle.
author: Marta S.

title: Great for a long stay
text: Stayed a month for work. Desk in the room was big enough, Wi-Fi was fast and stable for video calls, and housekeeping was flexible.
author: James K.

title: Lovely but noisy on weekends
text: Beautiful room and friendly staff. Street noise from the bars on Friday and Saturday nights; ask for a room at the back.
author: Ana P.

title: Breakfast was the highlight
text: Fresh pastéis de nata every morning and great coffee. Breakfast terrace has a view.
author: Lukas W.

title: Small rooms
text: Clean and central, but the standard double is tiny. Fine for a couple of nights, not for longer.
author: Priya R.

title: Quiet and comfortable
text: Very quiet at night, blackout curtains and a great mattress. Slept better than at home.
author: Tom H.

title: Good value for Lisbon
text: Price was fair for the area. Nothing fancy, but spotless and the staff gave excellent restaurant tips.
author: Sofia M.

title: Air conditioning struggled
text: In August the AC couldn't keep up and the room was warm all night. Staff tried to help.
author: Daniel O.

title: Staff went above and beyond
text: Reception organised a late check-out and called a taxi at 5am for our flight. Super kind.
author: Chen L.

title: Hilly but worth it
text: Lisbon is steep — be ready for hills. The hotel is close to the tram 28 stop, which helps.
author: Emma B.

title: Wi-Fi drops in the evening
text: The connection was slow after 8pm. Not great if you need to work; the lobby was better.
author: Rui C.

title: Spotless
text: Housekeeping was excellent every day. Bathroom was modern and very clean.
author: Hannah F.

title: Rooftop bar is busy
text: The rooftop is lovely at sunset but it's popular with non-guests, so it gets crowded.
author: Mateo G.

title: Ideal for families
text: Connecting rooms, cots provided, and the staff loved our kids. Pool was a hit.
author: Olivia T.

title: Easy airport transfer
text: 20 minutes by taxi from the airport, or the metro red/green line with one change.
author: Marta S.

title: Construction next door
text: Building work started at 8am on weekdays. Hotel didn't mention it when booking.
author: James K.

title: Monthly rate was excellent
text: Asked for a long-stay rate by email and got a big discount for 30 nights, with weekly cleaning.
author: Ana P.

title: Kitchenette is handy
text: Having a small kitchenette made a three-week stay much easier. Supermarket around the corner.
author: Lukas W.

title: Gorgeous historic building
text: Beautiful tiles and high ceilings. It feels like old Lisbon but the rooms are renovated.
author: Priya R.

title: Breakfast overpriced
text: €25 for an average buffet. Plenty of cafés nearby do a better breakfast for a third of the price.
author: Tom H.

title: Good gym
text: Gym was small but well equipped and open 24 hours, which suited my schedule.
author: Sofia M.

title: Very safe area
text: Walked back late at night and always felt safe. Well-lit streets and lots of people around.
author: Daniel O.

title: Elevator is tiny
text: Lovely hotel but the lift fits two people and a suitcase. Expect to wait at check-out time.
author: Chen L.

title: River views
text: Asked for a high floor and got a view of the Tagus. Sunsets from the room were unforgettable.
author: Emma B.

title: Thin walls
text: Could hear the neighbours' TV. Earplugs provided, which says it all.
author: Rui C.

title: Laundry service saved us
text: On a long trip the same-day laundry was a lifesaver and reasonably priced.
author: Hannah F.
